extras: Pro features require GitHub sponsorship. The plugin uses the editor extension API.
intentEvidence: Steady Inline Math keeps an active inline equation in math mode when you type a space next to a dollar sign in a plain paragraph.
problem: Typing spaces next to dollar signs in inline math within a plain paragraph can destabilize the math rendering in Live Preview.
summary: Steady Inline Math stabilizes inline equations by temporarily inserting and hiding empty braces when typing near dollar signs in Live Preview.
